# Day 3 — Uncertainty Extended and Expected

Day 3 covers combinatorics, random variables, expectation algebra, and
conditional expectation (the type-shift), closing with PDFs and CDFs for
continuous random variables. Calculus, which used to share this day, is
now its own session on [Day 4](../04-calculus/index.qmd). Programming
continues exploring R's data structures (factors, data frames),
conditionals, and descriptive statistics.

This session has two parts:

- **[Math Session](slides.qmd)** — the in-class slideshow.
- **[Programming Session](programming.qmd)** — a webpage walking through the
  same material with runnable R code.
